component.name: PerritoDeck
component.summary: Use a tablet as a programmable button deck

description.p: PerritoDeck turns an Android tablet or phone into a grid of buttons for your computer. Mute your microphone, switch OBS scenes, fire keyboard shortcuts, launch apps, control media and your smart home, with one tap.

This app runs the host in your tray: pair tablets with a code, lay out your buttons, and keep them working while the window is closed. Tablets connect over your own Wi-Fi or a USB cable. There is no account and no cloud.

ul.li: Encrypted pairing with a 6-digit code or a QR code
Pages, toggles, sliders, live values and animated keys
Profiles that switch with the focused app
Plugins for OBS Studio, Proxmox, MQTT, timers and more
